behaviour: Adds actionChangeArrowheadSize, which sets the arrowhead size of every selected line or arrow with a head, and its three-option panel control, and shows that control in the compact and mobile arrow popover.
rules: 1. Imports: DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE in the @excalidraw/common import, isArrowheadSize next to getArrowheadForPicker in the same @excalidraw/element import line, and ArrowheadSize in the @excalidraw/element/types type import; the icons FontSizeSmallIcon, FontSizeMediumIcon and FontSizeLargeIcon are already imported.

2. After actionChangeArrowhead, export `isArrowheadSizeTarget = (element: ExcalidrawElement): element is ExcalidrawLinearElement` returning isLinearElement(element) && (element.startArrowhead !== null || element.endArrowhead !== null), with a one-line comment.
3. Then export `actionChangeArrowheadSize = register<ArrowheadSize>({ name: "changeArrowheadSize", label: "labels.arrowheadSize", trackEvent: false, perform, PanelComponent })`.

4. perform(elements, appState, value, app): invariant(value, "actionChangeArrowheadSize: value must be defined"); elements = changeProperty(elements, appState, callback) where the callback returns a non-target unchanged, and for a target builds `newElementWith(el, { arrowheadSize: value })`, then, when isElbowArrow holds for it, re-routes it with newElementWith(element, updateElbowArrowRoute(element, app.scene.getNonDeletedElementsMap())) exactly as actionChangeArrowhead does.
5. perform returns { elements, captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY } and no appState key: no AppState field changes.

6. PanelComponent({ elements, appState, updateData, app }) renders
{t("labels.arrowheadSize")}
group="arrowhead-size" .../>
, shaped like actionChangeStrokeWidth's panel.

7. Options in order small, medium, large: text t("labels.arrowheadSize_small"), t("labels.arrowheadSize_medium"), t("labels.arrowheadSize_large"); icons FontSizeSmallIcon, FontSizeMediumIcon, FontSizeLargeIcon; testIds "arrowheadSize-small", "arrowheadSize-medium", "arrowheadSize-large".

8. value = getFormValue<ArrowheadSize | null>(elements, app, (element) => isArrowheadSizeTarget(element) && isArrowheadSize(element.arrowheadSize) ? element.arrowheadSize : DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE, isArrowheadSizeTarget, (hasSelection) => (hasSelection ? null : DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE)), so an absent size shows as medium and a mixed selection shows none; onChange={(value) => updateData(value)}.

9. actionChangeArrowProperties' PanelComponent (the compact and mobile arrow popover) first computes `const hasArrowheadSizeTarget = getTargetElements(getNonDeletedElements(elements), appState).some(isArrowheadSizeTarget);` (both helpers are already imported), then renders `{hasArrowheadSizeTarget && renderAction("changeArrowheadSize")}` right after `{renderAction("changeArrowhead")}`; its perform and the changeArrowType line are unchanged.

behaviour: Makes Paste styles set a linear target's arrowhead size to the copied linear element's, clearing it when the source has none.
rules: 1. Import isArrowheadSize and isLinearElement in the @excalidraw/element import block that holds isArrowElement; extend the type import to `import type { ExcalidrawLinearElement, ExcalidrawTextElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";` and add `import type { Mutable } from "@excalidraw/common/utility-types";` after it.
2. Copy styles needs no change: it already serializes the whole source element, arrowheadSize included.

3. In actionPasteStyles, right before the existing `if (newElement.type === "arrow" && isArrowElement(elementStylesToCopyFrom))` block, add a block guarded by isLinearElement(newElement) && isLinearElement(elementStylesToCopyFrom), with a one-line comment that the size matches the source like the other styles.
4. Inside it: when isArrowheadSize(elementStylesToCopyFrom.arrowheadSize), newElement = newElementWith(newElement, { arrowheadSize: elementStylesToCopyFrom.arrowheadSize }).

5. Otherwise, when newElement.arrowheadSize !== undefined: `const cleared = newElementWith(newElement, {}, true);` then `delete (cleared as Mutable<ExcalidrawLinearElement>).arrowheadSize;` then newElement = cleared, so the version bumps, the change is undoable, and the element serializes without the key.
6. Otherwise (source and target both without a size) newElement is left as it is, so no key appears.
7. The existing arrowheads block keeps running after this one, so an elbow target is re-routed with its new size when the source is an arrow.

sites.rule: Rule 1: the extended type import followed by the Mutable type import.

behaviour: Lets API.createElement take arrowheadSize for arrows and lines and pass it to the element factories.
rules: 1. The createElement options type gains `arrowheadSize?: T extends "arrow" | "line" ? ExcalidrawLinearElement["arrowheadSize"] : never;` after elbowed.
2. The newArrowElement call and the newLinearElement call each pass `arrowheadSize: rest.arrowheadSize,`; the factories drop an undefined value, so elements created without it keep no key.
3. Nothing else in the file changes, its existing formatting included.
